prose: Axios’s indexed excerpt reports Knit Health raised a $35 million Series A led by NEA to work on patient referrals and care planning using what the company calls an AI world model. The article body was inaccessible. Treatment-effect prediction and care optimization remain product claims, not demonstrated clinical outcomes.
highlights: Funding is attributed to Axios reporting
Patient referrals are the stated focus
World model is the company’s framing
